## Frequently asked questions

### Where is AEC Chennai?
AEC Akshaya (3rd Floor), #16, 3rd Main Road, 16th Street, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does AEC Chennai have?
Joint development & redevelopment, Civil contracts, PEB / structural steel roofing, Residential apartments, Bungalows & villas, Schools & academic blocks, Factories & industrial buildings, Warehouses (10,000–1,00,000 sq ft), Commercial projects, Renovation & remodelling, Turnkey projects.

### Do you take up redevelopment of old flats?
Yes. We specialise in joint development and redevelopment projects in and around Chennai.

### Can you build to my architect's design?
Yes. We take up civil engineering contracts for residences, industrial, commercial and educational buildings and warehouses. References are provided on request.

### Was any of your work recognised?
The Metallic Bellows admin block we built (designed by KSM Architecture) was shortlisted as a finalist at the World Architecture Festival 2023.

### How do I start a project with AEC Chennai?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it, or call +91 44 2267 1545.
